<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <ScrollView xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:fillViewport="true" android:background="@color/bg_gray">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:padding="20dp">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:layout_marginBottom="10dp">
<ImageView android:layout_width="42dp" android:layout_height="42dp" android:src="@drawable/fetch_logo" android:background="@drawable/bg_avatar_circle" android:padding="4dp" android:contentDescription="@string/app_name" />
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:orientation="vertical" android:paddingStart="10dp">
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvTrackingTitle" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/tracking_title" android:textSize="26sp" android:textStyle="bold" android:textColor="@color/brand_ink" />
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/tracking_subtitle" android:textColor="@color/text_grey" android:textSize="12sp" android:layout_marginTop="2dp" /> </LinearLayout> </LinearLayout>
<FrameLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="300dp" android:layout_marginBottom="12dp" android:background="@drawable/bg_card_white" android:padding="1dp">
<org.osmdroid.views.MapView android:id="@+id/trackingMapView" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" /> </FrameLayout>
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:background="@drawable/bg_card_white" android:padding="14dp" android:layout_marginBottom="12dp">
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvTrackingStatus" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/loading" android:textColor="@color/brand_ink" android:textStyle="bold" android:textSize="16sp" android:layout_marginBottom="4dp" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvCollectHint" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/tracking_collect_hint_default" android:textColor="@color/text_grey" android:textSize="14sp" /> </LinearLayout>
<Button android:id="@+id/btnNavigatePickup" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="56dp" android:text="@string/tracking_navigate_pickup" android:textAllCaps="false" android:textStyle="bold" android:background="@drawable/bg_button_secondary" app:backgroundTint="@null" android:textColor="@color/brand_red" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp" />
<Button android:id="@+id/btnNavigateDropoff" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="56dp" android:text="@string/tracking_navigate_dropoff" android:textAllCaps="false" android:textStyle="bold" android:background="@drawable/bg_button_secondary" app:backgroundTint="@null" android:textColor="@color/brand_red" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp" />
<Button android:id="@+id/btnArrivedDestination" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="56dp" android:text="@string/tracking_arrived_destination" android:textAllCaps="false" android:textStyle="bold" android:background="@drawable/bg_button_secondary" app:backgroundTint="@null" android:textColor="@color/brand_red" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp" />
<Button android:id="@+id/btnCompleteAndCollect" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="56dp" android:text="@string/tracking_complete_collect" android:textAllCaps="false" android:textStyle="bold" android:background="@drawable/bg_button_primary" app:backgroundTint="@null" android:textColor="@color/white" />
</LinearLayout> </ScrollView>
